Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a specialized differential alkylation strategy (12C-IPA and 13C-IPA) to determine the redox state of specific disulfide bonds. While not a standard LFQ or TMT run, it relies on relative ion abundance of isotopic labels for quantification. The target is the redox state of cysteines, mapping to a redox-focused workflow.

scope: Lysate and anti-β3 (AP3, RRID:AB_2056630), anti-α2β1 (clone P1E6; Abcam ab24697), or antitalin (clone 8d4, ab157808; Abcam) antibody (10 µg per sample) were mixed in 0.5 mL of wash buffer
The αIIbβ3, αVβ3, or α2β1 integrin was collected on 80 μL of protein A/G agarose with rotation for 2 hours at 25°C.
Biotin-labeled surface integrins were immunoprecipitated by using M-280 streptavidin Dynabeads (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to manufacturer’s instructions.
